steps.message: I’ll inspect the local Maven project under `/app`, confirm where `graphql-java.version` is declared, then apply the version bump and fix any compilation breakages against graphql-java 17 without touching tests.

todos.content: Inspect Maven manifests and current graphql-java version
Update graphql-java.version to 17.0 and any generated metadata if present
Build project to identify graphql-java 17 API breakages
Patch production code only and verify build/tests
